backup_restore.checksum: archive SHA-256 sidecar required for restore; integrity check only, not authentication or proof of origin
backup_restore.filesystem_metadata: preserve regular mode bits and safe relative symlinks; restore ownership as invoking user; ACLs/xattrs/resource forks are not preserved
backup_restore.full: portable data plus project/local/global indexes and stopped data/qdrant storage
full_compatibility: AWOKI_EMBEDDING_DEPLOYMENT_ID (actual served model/revision; required to prove non-empty Qdrant compatibility)
Qdrant matching digest/ID when available; mutable :latest must be proven or forced
backup_restore.named_volumes: Neovim state and SSH server host keys are not archived and are recreated
backup_restore.operation_lock: ephemeral regular file in .harness/state; standard MCP/OpenCode launchers and runtime Make targets refuse active operations and remove dead-PID stale locks; symlink/non-regular lock rejected
backup_restore.portable: workspace plus harness continuity/state/artifacts/memory/notes and configured global roots/skills; excludes derived indexes, Qdrant, credentials, OpenCode state, and named volumes
backup_restore.portable_restore: invalidates stale derived indexes, regenerates layout marker, rebuilds all project and all restored global lexical indexes, leaves code indexing opt-in; vector mode warns when alternate global roots need explicit follow-up
backup_restore.quiescence: portable backup may explicitly acknowledge live capture; full backup and every restore require all Awoki Compose services stopped
backup_restore.remote_qdrant: full mode captures only local data/qdrant bind storage; external Qdrant requires its own snapshot/backup
backup_restore.repository_portability: reject linked worktrees/submodules/alternates whose Git metadata or object store resolves outside workspace
backup_restore.restore_staging: verify and fully extract to private staging before force-clearing destination; check staging and external-target filesystem free space
backup_restore.secrets: dotenv, SSH client material, and OpenCode state require explicit opt-in; project data may still be sensitive
backup_restore.transaction_boundary: final apply across multiple filesystems is not atomic; retain source archive/old installation until verification

burp.architecture: hybrid: direct PortSwigger Burp MCP for live control, Awoki for evidence/project/handoff/RAG only
burp.coverage_policy: For domain/host claims, report live Burp checked, saved evidence checked, dedup policy, raw match count, unique endpoint count, not_scanned, confidence.
burp.default_find_scope: no fixed run limit by default; set limit_runs/run-limit only for bounded previews
burp.deprecated_default: Awoki Python pull/find/report wrappers are archive/bulk/offline helpers, not the default live Burp workflow
burp.extracted_request_policy: single extracted .http working files may be written under project artifacts/burp/extracted; full raw Burp history remains global
burp.host_report_policy: host reports scan relevant saved inventories with no fixed run limit by default and write compact artifacts, not raw traffic
burp.live_mcp_server: opencode mcp.burp remote -> http://host.docker.internal:9876 with Host/Origin headers
burp.lookup_policy: use structured Awoki Burp reader tools; do not manually parse raw MCP JSON unless explicitly required
burp.parser_notes: PortSwigger MCP history output is serialized JSON text and may be truncated per item, so Awoki parser accepts JSON, JSONL, arrays, and truncated request/response string fragments.
burp.project_pointer_policy: Burp project storage is optional and created lazily only after explicit Burp preservation/write activity; project-related runs and host reports then write lightweight pointers/artifacts under workspace/projects/<project>/artifacts/burp without copying raw history
burp.repeater_intruder_policy: read via active editor fallback; create/send via PortSwigger MCP tools through Awoki scripts
burp.run_naming: project_first: <project_id>__<timestamp>__<run_type>; global__<timestamp>__<run_type> when no project is specified

code_analysis.authorship: Git author/committer fields are unverified metadata claims; signature presence is recorded but configured external signature verifiers are not executed automatically
code_analysis.deterministic_semantics: code_semantics_check executes only a fixed allow-listed Go language/stdlib helper with module/network fetching disabled and never executes repository code; toolchain alignment is reported for version-sensitive stdlib observations
code_analysis.diagnostics: view=diagnostics returns global retrieval telemetry first, optional exact diagnostic_targets, compact reranker-selected summaries, and a short-lived project-scoped metadata-only trace handle; code_diagnostics_trace provides bounded paging or path/symbol lookup without source previews or client cache scraping
code_analysis.discovery: codebase_search; FTS/Qdrant/reranker broaden discovery while authority/diversity prefer query-relevant production for implementation intent without globally excluding tests/config; structural promotion is candidate generation only and never behavioral proof
code_analysis.flow_graph: code_flow_graph; bounded relevant subgraph; traverse resolved calls only; preserve ambiguous/unresolved boundaries
code_analysis.history_boundary: local provenance cannot prove rewritten, unreachable, garbage-collected, or remote-only commits never existed; shallow/grafted/replaced local history views are disclosed
code_analysis.project_open_index_advice: project_open and project_repo_add passively return per-repository structural/vector freshness; stale local structural indexes recommend detached code_index_refresh_start first, with bounded code_index_refresh_status progress and explicit cancellation; semantic vectors remain a separate opt-in code_vector_refresh_start job and are never refreshed merely because a project was opened or a checkout/corpus was registered
code_analysis.raw_search_fallback: conceptual/architectural discovery uses codebase_search/structural search; OpenCode native Grep is normal bounded exact string/symbol lookup; code_exact_search is the first-class structured ripgrep path for complex/exhaustive exact enumeration without Bash; code_text_search is the deterministic exhaustive-coverage/transport-recovery path; lexical discovery is never behavioral proof; active acceptance contracts may restrict native tools
code_analysis.repository_provenance: VERIFIED_SNAPSHOT | WORKING_TREE_BOUND | FILESYSTEM_BOUND; exact Git root/HEAD/tree/view anomalies are materialized during refresh/verify, while unusual state lowers assurance rather than hiding source
code_analysis.repository_readiness: repository-readiness skill: idempotent managed-scope preparation; local-ready requires current structural/FTS, full-ready additionally requires explicit semantic-vector materialization, current published membership, and healthy configured Qdrant/embedding/reranker backends; detached jobs are never tight-polled
code_analysis.repository_scope: one legacy Git repository, multiple registered Git roots, or registered non-Git textual evidence sources per project; broad discovery spans enabled sources and exact operations fail on ambiguity without repo=/source_id=
code_analysis.runtime_boundary: static source/graph evidence does not prove a runtime execution occurred
code_analysis.source: code_source_window; bounded hash-checked source with compact evidence_id binding exact bytes/range to Git repository/view identity or non-Git content-manifest revision identity; truncation reports explicit reasons, clipped lines, and continuation guidance
code_analysis.source_evidence: code_evidence_verify checks compact checksum-protected evidence IDs for source-byte plus Git snapshot/view or non-Git corpus-manifest drift; evidence IDs are not signatures or authorship attestations
code_analysis.strict_proof: code_validate_claim selectively validates supported source propositions; code_semantics_check is mandatory guidance for supported deterministic Go primitive/runtime claims

embedding.dimension: 768 for the bundled TEI/Jina example; runtime vectors remain authoritative

memory_policy.canonical_redaction: coverage-first analysis-aware value redaction before continuity append; redaction alone does not imply no_rag

policies.stabilization: R9.1.6.16 freezes discretionary feature expansion; use realistic security/code-review journeys to keep/simplify/merge/remove mechanisms before adding persistent concepts. See docs/USEFULNESS_EVALUATION.md and docs/AWOKI_IDENTITY.md.

projects.acceptance_evidence_store: Rich Awoki-produced acceptance support is opt-in content-addressed ev_ evidence under project artifacts/acceptance/raw/evidence. Stable ev_ identity is content-addressed while a bounded non-RAG provenance sidecar records which acceptance runs captured the artifact, allowing current-run evidence requirements to be machine-enforced without duplicating payloads.
projects.acceptance_runs: acceptance_run_* v4 stores compact typed project/source-scoped observations, bounded durable test contracts, immutable per-test aat_ attempt history, machine-evaluated prior-attempt requirements, separate execution/orchestration provenance, optional per-interface invocation ceilings, and trigger-tagged compaction generation history. Claimed PASS can be downgraded when required interfaces, declared pass/prior-attempt requirements, evidence scope, invocation limits, or tool policy are not satisfied. Incomplete finalize remains resumable and source revision or published vector membership drift fails closed; model inference is never upgraded into machine proof.
projects.durable_continuation: Repository readiness correctness is project/repo/source-scoped in repository_prepare_* state, not chat-scoped. project_continuation_* is an optional session notification/resume layer that can wait on repository_prepare_status; failure to wake an idle OpenCode conversation does not affect repository preparation correctness.
projects.durable_work_ledger: OpenCode todo.updated snapshots are persisted as bounded local session work state under .harness/state using Awoki-owned stable atd_ IDs, including unattached/ad-hoc sessions. For multi-step natural-language work the TODO projection is the small active deliverable/constraint working set; current-session human reference usage is tracked in the same ledger so older project refs stay searchable without recency-based compaction injection. New user turns mark older TODO/reference state needs-review; this operational state is not canonical project knowledge.
projects.generic_tasks: project_task_checkpoint/project_task_status/project_task_finalize; Burp task tools are scoped to live Burp workflows only
projects.project_open_index_advice: project_open and project_repo_add passively return per-repository structural/vector freshness. For explicit end-to-end readiness use repository_prepare_start; the project/repo/source-scoped parent job owns structural refresh, vector materialization, exact membership verification, and backend probes without model polling. Opening/registering never authorizes remote embedding.
projects.repository_layout: legacy exact root at workspace/projects/<project_id>/repo or explicit registered child roots under repo/<repo_id>
projects.repository_management: project_repo_add/project_repo_list/project_repo_remove/project_repo_default; natural add-repo requests infer repo/<repo_id>; registration never clones or deletes checkout files
projects.source_layout: registered non-Git textual evidence roots under workspace/projects/<project_id>/sources/<source_id>; identity is a canonical content-manifest hash, independent of mtime/inode/copy order
projects.source_management: project_source_add/project_source_list/project_source_remove/project_source_default; source registration is local-only and never implies remote embedding/vector materialization

reliability.always_loaded: AGENTS.md plus docs/RELIABILITY.md via OpenCode instructions
reliability.assessment_model: flexible note/claim/hypothesis/observation/question/gap/contradiction/decision nodes with strict authority, evidence provenance, first-class relations, and lifecycle; notes are non-gating
reliability.corrective_budget: single durable atomic counter owned by the reliability run and consumed explicitly before a bounded corrective action; checkpoints never consume budget
reliability.cross_ledger_verdict: reliability_aggregate_verdict preserves reliability and acceptance component verdicts before computing an explicit overall verdict
reliability.delivery_gate: ship-check requires explicit authorization for remote actions
reliability.instruction_delivery: AGENTS.md plus OpenCode instructions; no dynamic system-message append
reliability.ledger: project reports/reliability JSON+Markdown; failed or missing required checks cannot finalize as passed
reliability.structured_claim_gate: ship-mode required claims must carry deterministic verifier receipts; INCONCLUSIVE/STALE block, REFUTED/CONFLICT fail, model-authored VERIFIED is not accepted without a machine verifier receipt, and zero required claims is NOT_APPLICABLE outside ship mode rather than vacuous success
reliability.validation_contract: make validate is dependency-tolerant host/hermetic validation; make validate-runtime additionally requires real ripgrep, bundled tree-sitter runtime, and runtime code-search/Qdrant evaluation
reliability.verification_checkpoint: VERIFIED|VERIFIED_WITH_FINDINGS|INCOMPLETE|CONTRADICTED|BLOCKED|NOT_APPLICABLE with explicit unresolved findings and no self-certification of model inference

retrieval.code_branch_policy: active branch by default; vector content identity separated from project/branch/path membership
retrieval.code_claim_validation: exact current-source hashes, symbol/AST/lexical obligations, and edge-by-edge validation of candidate graph paths; no embeddings or reranking
retrieval.code_diagnostics_trace: bounded project-scoped retrieval of short-lived metadata-only code-search diagnostic traces by page or path/symbol target; never returns source previews
retrieval.code_evaluation: hermetic release suites cover smoke, graph, security, cross-project, and branch behavior; runtime gate additionally requires multilingual Tree-sitter parsing and live Qdrant contribution/cleanup
retrieval.code_historical_baseline: frozen parent-commit observation at .harness/evaluation/code_search/baselines/pre-structural-98f5431.json; no runtime legacy backend
retrieval.code_multi_repo_scope: project structural SQLite and code Qdrant are shared derived stores but repo_id namespaces files/chunks/branches/vector memberships/evidence/completeness independently
retrieval.code_parsers: pinned bundled Tree-sitter grammars with deterministic Python AST and generic deterministic text fallback for normal textual non-prose source/config formats; parser support never gates primary code discovery; no runtime grammar downloads
retrieval.code_scope: repository structural index plus exhaustive textual repository fallback; parser support never defines lexical completeness
retrieval.code_text_search: policy-gated exhaustive ripgrep fallback with clean-index-manifest eligibility reuse, explicit include_ignored forensic mode, server-side materialized search cache, operation-budget resumption, multi-path scope, final match counting, bounded per-match previews, giant-line-safe byte offsets, snapshot-bound cursors, and explicit incomplete status on per-file timeout
retrieval.code_vector_materialization: interactive code search never creates remote vectors implicitly; project_open/project_repo_add expose passive repository_index_advice and explicit project_refresh(include_code=true, include_qdrant=true) materialization. Transient embedding transport failures receive bounded worker-level retry/backoff and adaptive batch reduction; permanent auth/schema/dimension failures are not retried as transport errors. End-to-end readiness should use repository_prepare_* rather than model-chaining child jobs.
retrieval.codebase_search: native structural code index with deterministic lexical/conceptual/exact routing, per-query FTS/Qdrant/reranker diagnostic controls, raw stage provenance, bounded verified structural candidate expansion, query-intent authority ranking, deterministic diversity, clean-Git snapshot reuse, bounded top-K metadata, and explicit reranker requested/attempted/applied telemetry; interactive search never rebuilds remote vectors implicitly; lexical FTS includes language-neutral identifier normalization plus a bounded local separator/camelCase text bridge before ordinary FTS+Qdrant fusion
retrieval.cross_project_code_search: requires an explicit project list or explicit all_indexed=true
retrieval.durable_continuation: Repository readiness correctness is project/repo/source-scoped in repository_prepare_* state, not chat-scoped. project_continuation_* is an optional session notification/resume layer that can wait on repository_prepare_status; failure to wake an idle OpenCode conversation does not affect repository preparation correctness.
retrieval.embedding_default: remote OpenAI-compatible endpoint; no local embedding model weights
retrieval.fallback: sqlite_fts and jsonl_scan remain available for exact continuity recall; embedding/Qdrant errors are reported and never fabricate semantic hits
retrieval.memory_reconciliation: new project captures compare against prior continuity records only; Qdrant queries use the memory_record payload filter
retrieval.qdrant: core semantic vector store; explicit index tools write vectors produced by the configured remote embedding endpoint
retrieval.raw_search_fallback: structural search -> OpenCode native Grep for simple exact lookup -> code_exact_search for full structured ripgrep operations -> code_text_search only when machine-complete exhaustive coverage/transport recovery is required; code_text_search is the materialized exhaustive-coverage/transport-recovery MCP primitive and materializes exhaustive declared-scope repository text once, supports explicit include_ignored forensic scope, never whole-file excludes normal security/credential source merely for secret-like identifiers, redacts high-confidence literal credentials best-effort at derived-text/transport boundaries, resumes discovery within an operation budget, and distinguishes eligible scanner completeness from repository-source completeness
retrieval.raw_secret_paths: obvious textual secret/config files are local-lexical-only with opaque previews and never structurally indexed/embedded; explicit no-rag exclusions are counted and prevent repository_universe_complete; ordinary security source is never excluded by vocabulary
retrieval.reranker: optional remote HTTP reranker over bounded fused FTS/Qdrant candidates; failure defaults to fused order
retrieval.sqlite_fts: enabled and refreshed only when the safe project/global document set is stale

runtime.burp_mcp_direct: opencode.jsonc mcp.burp remote uses concrete http://host.docker.internal:9876 with Host/Origin headers; no env placeholder
runtime.burp_runtime_boundary: live Burp remains direct mcp.burp; only Awoki Burp archive/helper CLI uses the non-retrieval burp runtime profile when invoked inside the SSH container
runtime.docker_network: awoki-data (internal Qdrant) plus awoki-egress (OpenCode/MCP remote endpoint and host Burp access)
runtime.embedding_benchmark: make embedding-benchmark runs fixed synthetic single/bulk OpenAI-compatible embedding latency probes through the retrieval profile using Python standard-library HTTP; no repository text is sent
runtime.git_passive_read_safety: repository-local Git reads disable fsmonitor and lazy promisor fetching, remove repository-rebinding/transient config environment overrides, neutralize configured content-filter helpers for status, and do not automatically invoke configured GPG/SSH signature verifiers
runtime.go_semantics_runtime: Docker images pin Go 1.26.5 from the official golang:1.26.5-bookworm stage for allow-listed deterministic code_semantics_check probes; GOTOOLCHAIN=local, module/proxy/sumdb/VCS access, inherited Go tool-execution configuration, and cgo are disabled; repository code is never executed; project go.mod major.minor alignment is reported
runtime.lavish_runtime_boundary: Lavish shell commands use the non-retrieval lavish runtime profile so custom port/version/state survive sshd without placing embedding/reranker API keys in the npx child environment; this is not a same-user sandbox
runtime.mcp_preflight: .harness/bin/mcp-preflight runs during both image builds, SSH container startup, and mcp-local startup
runtime.mcp_python_sdk: maintained v1 FastMCP line constrained to mcp>=1.29,<2; MCP 2.x is rejected until Awoki is deliberately migrated
runtime.mcp_runtime_environment_handoff: the SSH entrypoint atomically writes allowlisted Compose values to root plus the op primary group, mode-0640 /run/awoki/runtime.env on tmpfs; mcp-auto validates the snapshot then relaunches mcp-local through the clean secret-bearing mcp profile rather than inheriting arbitrary SSH/OpenCode environment
runtime.mcp_stderr_log: .harness/state/mcp-local.stderr.log; stderr is mirrored to OpenCode and the durable log
runtime.opencode_config_note: Run plain opencode from the repo root; do not use opencode --config.
runtime.repository_subprocess_environment: passive Git reads and exhaustive ripgrep scans strip retrieval/provider credentials plus ambient Python/loader/SSH-agent/caller-selected Git SSH helper variables before launch; deterministic Go semantics uses a fixed clean environment; this is defense in depth, not same-user sandboxing
runtime.rerank_key_indirection: AWOKI_RERANK_API_KEY_ENV is local-process/advanced indirection; the retrieval backend validates the variable name and fails before network use when an explicitly named credential is invalid, absent, or empty; the SSH entrypoint additionally normalizes a present named credential into AWOKI_RERANK_API_KEY and fails startup when reranking is enabled but the named value is absent/empty; stock Compose users set AWOKI_RERANK_API_KEY directly unless an override injects the named variable
runtime.reranker_benchmark: make reranker-benchmark runs a fixed synthetic reranker query/candidate probe through the retrieval profile using Python standard-library HTTP; no repository text is sent
runtime.runtime_config_diagnostic: make runtime-config works from host or SSH container and prints the effective runtime configuration with API keys redacted and URL credentials/query strings removed
runtime.runtime_env_diagnostic_wrapper: .harness/bin/awoki-runtime-env restores the root-owned SSH runtime snapshot into a clean explicit child with profile-filtered base/qdrant/retrieval/burp/lavish/internal-mcp/all environments; production file/directory trust is validated and printed URLs/secrets are redacted
runtime.runtime_env_security_limit: profiles minimize accidental inherited variables but are not a same-user sandbox: stdio mcp-auto runs as op and therefore the op runtime user can deliberately read /run/awoki/runtime.env; do not execute hostile target/tool code in a credential-bearing analysis container
runtime.tmux_config: vendored gpakosz/.tmux main config under /opt/oh-my-tmux with Awoki local override at /home/op/.tmux.conf.local
runtime.tmux_integrity: .harness/vendor/oh-my-tmux/UPSTREAM.md records source, retrieval date, licenses, and SHA-256 hashes; no startup download
runtime.tmux_validation: .harness/bin/tmux-check runs at image build and SSH startup; make opencode-runtime-check repeats tmux and MCP checks

runtime_dependencies.policy: Critical runtime behavior dependencies are recorded in one reviewed lock manifest. OpenCode uses a reviewed latest-or-operator-selected-safe policy: fresh latest builds resolve the CLI and materialize the local plugin/SDK at the exact resolved CLI version, while safe mode uses an exact operator-selected version; the running container never auto-updates. Lavish and Qdrant retain reviewed explicit defaults. Updates require lock/build/config changes, validation, image rebuild, runtime compatibility checks, and acceptance before a resolved OpenCode stack is treated as known good.

tools.code_exact_search: structured repository-scoped ripgrep exact search without shell command construction; supports multiple expressions, match/file/count modes, bounded context, include/exclude globs, hidden/ignored-file policy, credential-stripped subprocess environment, source-aware redaction, and explicit offset continuation; no arbitrary raw CLI passthrough
tools.code_text_search: repository-source exhaustive ripgrep fallback with source-aware secret handling, clean-index-manifest eligibility reuse, explicit include_ignored forensic scope, server-side materialized search cache, operation-budget resumption, multi-path scope, final match counting, bounded redacted per-match previews, giant-line-safe byte offsets, snapshot-bound cursors, explicit eligible/repository completeness, and incomplete status on source exclusion or per-file timeout
